# Reliability Checklist: Arm The Accidentally-Advisory State Bookkeeping Checks

**Purpose**: Validate that ART-017's reliability requirements are complete, deterministic, fail-closed, and measurable before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` workflow for the `reliability` domain. It validates requirements writing, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the three current-run state invariants specified as independently blocking under the exact `status-evidence` authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001-FR-003, Contract §Required Blocking Keys]
- [x] CHK002 Is the clean-control success requirement defined under the same scoped invocation as the three negative controls? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009-FR-011, Spec §SC-003-SC-004]
- [x] CHK003 Are legacy structural coverage findings required to remain visible without becoming blocking under `status-evidence`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-006, Contract §Required Blocking Keys]
- [x] CHK004 Is complete diagnostic-report preservation required when a newly selected problem key fails the scoped gate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007-FR-008, Contract §Report Shape Contract]
- [x] CHK005 Are rule membership, intent verdict, negative-control evidence, corpus evidence, authored guidance, and two-distribution parity all included in the same reliability slice? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005-FR-020, Plan §Implementation Approach]

## Deterministic Corpus Discovery

- [x] CHK006 Is pair eligibility defined by both paths being tracked, same-directory adjacency, and exact repo-relative `workflow_file` authority? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012-FR-015, Data Model §Workflow/State Pair]
- [x] CHK007 Does the plan define a deterministic git-index enumeration source and stable ordering for tracked workflow/state discovery, rather than relying on filesystem glob order or untracked local files? [Determinism, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Constraints, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [x] CHK008 Are workflows with missing, untracked, mismatched, or synthetic state explicitly excluded from authority-matched validation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012-FR-015, Contract §Workflow/State Pair Corpus Contract]
- [x] CHK009 Does the specification require a non-vacuous discovery census that accounts for every tracked workflow candidate and proves every eligible authority-matched pair was invoked exactly once? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Requirement Traceability]
- [x] CHK010 Is exact repo-relative authority matching distinguished from directory-only adjacency so the shared `.process/autopilot-state.json` cannot be treated as authority for every workflow in that directory? [Clarity, Spec §US2 Acceptance Scenario 3, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is pair-level success measurable as 100% of eligible authority-matched pairs with zero mismatched or synthesized pairs included? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Failure, Exception, and Recovery Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are independent failure requirements measurable by exit `1`, target-key population, and emptiness of every other `status-evidence`-selected key? [Failure Causality, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK013 Is a clean local result prevented from hiding legacy coverage debt by requiring non-member diagnostics to remain in the full report? [Reliability, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-006-SC-007]
- [x] CHK014 Are multi-diagnostic malformed states covered without permitting fail-fast loss of diagnostic information? [Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Report Shape Contract]
- [x] CHK015 Are guard input errors distinguished from scoped invariant failures through the existing exit and report contract? [Consistency, Contract §Exit Code Contract, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK016 Are rollback or recovery expectations bounded to reverting the explicit rule/intent change and regenerating derived surfaces rather than introducing a feature flag? [Scope, Spec §PR Review Packet Requirements, Plan §Complexity Tracking]

## Authored and Generated Surface Ownership

- [x] CHK017 Are the authored validator, authored autopilot skill paragraph, and authored unit test named as the only direct implementation surfaces? [Ownership, Plan §Declared File Operations, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [x] CHK018 Are Claude/Codex payloads, installed-cache fixtures, proof/evidence JSON, and docs-reference pages classified as derived outputs while both active client source skills remain authored? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK019 Is hand editing prohibited for every generated payload, proof, installed-cache, Codex, and docs-reference surface, with both client distributions required to pass same-source consistency evidence? [Reliability, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Constraints, Quickstart §Release Artifact Refresh]
- [x] CHK020 Are repository-owned regeneration commands identified separately for release artifacts and docs references? [Dependencies, Plan §Requirement Traceability, Quickstart §Release Artifact Refresh]
- [x] CHK021 Does final freshness evidence require the independent release-artifact consistency check after regeneration so a clean targeted or full test run cannot mask stale generated payloads or proofs? [Reliability, Spec §FR-018, Spec §SC-008, Plan §Implementation Approach]

## Final Integration and Evidence Freshness

- [x] CHK022 Is ART-008 explicitly independent during authored development while shared derived surfaces are serialized at final integration? [Dependencies, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Rebase then regenerate before ready or merge]
- [x] CHK023 Are final readiness requirements ordered against one recorded latest-main HEAD—rebase, regenerate, consistency checks, targeted checks, then full suite—so pre-rebase or pre-regeneration green evidence cannot be reused? [Evidence Freshness, Spec §FR-018, Spec §SC-008, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [x] CHK024 Are docs reference generation and checking required after shared source changes rather than inferred from a clean Python suite? [Reliability, Plan §Phase 0 Research Summary, Quickstart §Release Artifact Refresh]
- [x] CHK025 Is the full repository suite required before ready or merge in addition to focused bookkeeping-guard coverage? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Quickstart §Full Verification]
- [x] CHK026 Does the PR evidence bundle require separate Claude Code and Codex artifact freshness, targeted checks, full-suite evidence, known gaps, and final ART-008 integration notes? [Traceability, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020, Spec §PR Review Packet Requirements, Spec §SC-008-SC-009]

## Acceptance Criteria and Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 Can reviewers measure that exactly 3 of 3 new keys are armed and zero additional advisory keys move? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001-SC-002]
- [x] CHK028 Can reviewers measure report compatibility by comparing top-level field and diagnostic-key sets before and after the authority change? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Contract §Report Shape Contract]
- [x] CHK029 Are Python 3.11+ standard-library, no-new-runtime-dependency, and no-active-Bash-or-`jq` constraints explicit for authored tooling? [Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context, Constitution §II]
- [x] CHK030 Are ART-014 dependency, the remaining advisory-key boundary, and latest-main integration assumptions documented without making ART-017 depend on ART-008? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Open Questions]

## Notes

- Remediation loop 1 closed four requirement gaps for deterministic discovery, non-vacuous pair accounting, generated-artifact freshness, and final evidence ordering.
- Evidence: `spec.md` §FR-013-FR-014, §FR-018, §FR-020, §SC-005, and §SC-008-SC-009; `plan.md` §Constraints, §Implementation Approach, and §Requirement Traceability.
- Requirement-ID audit: the three letter-suffixed functional-requirement IDs added during the interrupted draft were replaced with unique three-digit IDs because the autopilot traceability contract extracts `FR-XXX` markers from `spec.md`; the approved cross-platform clarification extends the canonical sequence through `FR-020` without suffixes.
- Codebase evidence: git-index enumeration currently finds 63 tracked `.process` workflow candidates sharing one tracked adjacent state, with one authority-matched pair and 62 authority-mismatch exclusions. The census requirements prevent either the eligible pair or the exclusions from disappearing behind a vacuous green result.
- Optional checklist hooks were git commit prompts only and were not executed because this delegated task is non-committing.
